leo: FYI ran the new reranker-candidate-format change on staging. overall NDCG@10 +1.2% but MRR@5 -3.1%. exact-match and short-query slices worst.
anita: what changed in candidate format?
leo: retrieval now outputs candidates as newline-separated snippet blocks ("\n") instead of space-separated tokens with explicit <SEP> marker. offline eval used <SEP>.
ryan: oof. that affects how we concatenate context when priming the reranker. sentencepiece treats newlines differently -> token boundary shifts.
leo: here's the eval cmd I ran:
```
./eval_rerank --gold holdout_v4.json --pred preds_v4_newline.json --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@5 --slices short_exact,tail --tokenizer spm_v4 --cand-format newline --preproc-checksum d41d8cd9
```
anita: do you have a quick repro? any example qids where ordering flipped?
leo: uploaded a tiny repro and diffs to s3: s3://redwood-eval/artifacts/rerank/v4/1746667770/ (examples.jsonl + token_diffs.csv). One case: qid=Q12 fp32 ranks [D5,D2,D1] (gold D5), newlines-run ranks [D2,D5,D1] so MRR loss. tokenized prompt differences: fp32 prompt uses <SEP> tokens -> tokens: [.., 45, 102] newlines -> tokens: [.., 45, 3005] (different boundaries).
ryan: interesting that NDCG went up but MRR down. suggests better tail reordering but more top-1 swaps for short queries.
anita: did you test fp32 vs int8?
leo: ran both on the newline format: fp32 ndcg +1.2 mrr -1.1; int8 ndcg +1.5 mrr -3.1. quant amplifies the top-1 instability but root cause is candidate concatenation/sep token.
ryan: mitigation plan: 1) enforce candidate-format parity in onboarding artifact (include cand-format field), 2) add a tiny deterministic tie-breaker by doc_id hash to stabilize quant runs, 3) short-query CI smoke (200 qids) that checks MRR delta vs golden for both fp32 and target quant, 4) update model card with "candidate-format sensitivity" note.
leo: opening PRs for onboarding schema change + CI job + tie-breaker prototyping. also added a small script reproduce_concat.sh in the PR that swaps separators and reruns a 250-q quick check.
anita: can we add a preflight deployment check that verifies candidate-format and preproc checksum match the offline eval artifact? would have caught this.
ryan: +1. we should also add a tokenization parity unit test that hashes a few hundred sample prompts under both concat styles and flags large token id shifts.
eval-bot: staging snapshot created: rerank-v4-newline-2026-03-16T09:12:00Z :rocket:
leo: thanks. I'll attach the token-diff heatmap and failing qids in the PR. tagging @eng-ml reviewers.
anita: resolving with follow-ups: PRs for schema + CI, tie-breaker experiment, model card update, add preflight assert.
ryan: good catch, short messages like this are sneaky. :mag:
